claims.quote: Type locality is 'Orinoco River, Venezuela', but this species is widely distributed throughout the upper Orinoco, Casiquiare Canal and middle-to-lower Amazon region in Venezuela and Brazil, with records from the rios Negro, Madeira, Trombetas, Xingu and Tapajós.
